purpose: Prospective manual in-context next-opinion predictions by the assistant; no weight training or API model calls.
selection: Sort IDs by SHA256(seed|role|qid); select first20 newly added validation questions and first8 original training questions. One boundary per question cycles t=0..7 in selected order. Select8 agents per test question and one per training example by a separate SHA256 order, without consulting outcomes.
task: Estimate P(next five-vote majority opinion is A) at the pre-message forecasting boundary, given the current community state. Predict the source agents, not mathematical answer correctness.
inputs: Question and choice text, all32 persona texts, current majority opinions, signed graph, boundary t, target agent IDs. No raw vote counts, screened probabilities, mathematical solution/correct label, previous/future message text, next outcomes, source log probabilities, or competing predictor outputs.
information_boundary: Only s[t] is exported from each test episode. No other time from that test question is exported, preventing a later input from exposing an earlier test label. Messages generated in the predicted update are future information and excluded.
demonstrations: Eight original training questions only, one labeled agent update per question. No retrieval, examples or prompt changes based on test outcomes. The context is learned within the prompt; model weights are unchanged.
forecast_policy: Read only instructions.txt, demonstrations.json and test_inputs.json. Write all160 probabilities once before revealing outcomes. Do not inspect experiment selection, source episodes/chunks, label files, source probabilities, or baseline predictions while forecasting. Do not revise predictions after scoring.
comparison: Compare on the identical160 cases with the original frozen80-question 818-parameter transformer and Ising19, plus current-opinion persistence. Additional raw text and extensive pretraining make this a diagnostic, not a matched parameter/training-budget comparison. Raw persona/question text corresponds to the semantic content of compact model context but is not the same compressed representation.
metrics: Per-question mean log loss, Brier score and accuracy; equal weight per20 questions. P(A)>=.5 predicts A. Question-bootstrap intervals5000 draws, fixed seed. No individual-transition independence assumption.
scope: Exploratory manual pilot across20 question groups,160 agent forecasts at one boundary per question. It does not measure full-trajectory accuracy. These newly added validation questions become used development data after scoring. All40 reserved assessment questions remain untouched.
blinding_limit: Procedural separation with committed hashes and no label display until predictions are sealed, not a security boundary against a filesystem user. Existing public MATH problems may occur in pretraining; the fresh sampled agent-update outcomes are the unseen targets. Prior study summaries already exist in chat and cannot be erased.
